pages.title: Strange Matter
pages.text: Quark matter laced with strange quarks, possibly more stable than ordinary nuclei. A drop of it converts any normal matter it touches into more of itself, given the chance. It is dense, dull and should be kept very far from everything.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Witten's strange matter hypothesis haunted me as I ran Strange Matter Pellets through the Particle Spectrometer with quark-gluon plasma. The spectrum showed a third quark flavour dissolving into the mix and staying.
